**mrAutoMerge apply batch — TODO regex and deferred fixture for #886**

**What**: sdd-apply for issue-886-mr-auto-merge shipped sections 1-7 of tasks.md as 8 local commits on feat/issue-886-featvcs-mrautomerge-merge-by-tier-on-the (worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-886), all green except the one check red by design (verb-contract-drift-guard.test.mjs :82, D5).
**Why**: Task 2.1 (live capture of GitHub's real "auto-merge is not allowed" stderr) is a mutating write that needs a real open PR — explicitly deferred by the orchestrator for this batch, to be done by the maintainer or a follow-up batch against issue-886's own PR once opened.
**Where**: brain/scripts/vcs/fixtures/github-mrAutoMerge-unsupported.json (derived:true placeholder), brain/scripts/vcs/providers/github.mjs (GITHUB_MR_AUTO_MERGE_UNSUPPORTED_RE marked TODO), brain/scripts/vcs/providers/vcs.contract.test.mjs (one contract case marked `{ todo: 'fixture pending live capture (tasks 2.1)' }`).
**Learned**: A grep-based source guard test (auto-merge-outcome.test.mjs) that scans provider source for a hand-constructed `enabled:` literal false-positived on its OWN file's JSDoc `@returns` type annotations (`{enabled:true,url:null}`, no space) once real provider source existed to scan — fixed by requiring a space after the colon in the regex (`enabled:\s+(true|false)`), matching this repo's actual Prettier/ESLint object-literal style and excluding the compact JSDoc form. Next session (or the maintainer): run task 2.1's read-only-safe capture against an already-open PR on csrinaldi/brain, replace the fixture with recorded:true + verbatim stderr, un-todo the contract test, and revisit GITHUB_MR_AUTO_MERGE_UNSUPPORTED_RE against the real text before the PR opens for review.
